decision.authority: Project owner requested deployment of 2.5.71 before completing S6. The owner reviews and commits this content-bound interim policy and explicitly selects its commit for the release tag. This records interim publication only, not an independent cryptographic verdict or S6 completion; see docs/release.md. On 2026-10-30 the owner additionally deferred only TestOwnedReadyTargetTimingFourGenuineSources and TestOwnedReadyNormalTimedFactoryLoadsOriginalAndSignsWithoutGate from the Node release-test selector for source version 2.5.71. Both inactive D1 diagnostics remain required in the full suite and D1 acceptance; all other product and Node tests remain mandatory. Deferred is not PASS; see docs/release.md.
